senses.gloss: f. (צְדֵי II) desolation, confusion, despair (corresp. to h. שַׁמָּה).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 13:9">Targ. Is. XIII, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 32:10">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXII, 10</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="R00459"><he>צר׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 109:10">Targ. Ps. CIX, 10</cite> <he>מה הוות צָדוּתְהוֹן</he> Ms. (ed. Lag. <he>צדיתהון</he>; oth. ed. <he>מדהוות צרתהון</he>, corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:37">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 37</cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. Naḥ., p. 126ᵇ (Hebr. dict.) <he>מושיבה צ׳</he>, (not <he>צרו</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00590"><he>פִּיד</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 918:4">Yalk. Job 918</cite>.
Lam. R. to I, 13 (expl. שוממה a. דוה ib.) שוממה לצ׳ דוה לגרדום shomemah means doomed to desolation, davah, to execution.
